data.body: RC-B fix bundle F6 (severity-rubric anchors) shipped in PR #106 https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/106. Adds four named carve-outs to reviewer-base.md targeting the severity-inflation subset of this ticket (trust-boundary on already-public config), ee3a-43fc (false 'undefined' / hallucinated absence), and b2ef-cd72 (severity-inflated 'Important'). Prompt-only edit; all code-reviewer-* agents inherit reviewer-base.md. Ticket remains open pending CI telemetry on next PR cycle to confirm anchors reduce false-positive rate. F4 (structured verification_evidence) and F7b (file+line fingerprint matcher for cross-cycle convergence) are deferred follow-ons.
